notes.text: “Behold”, from “ הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

notes.after: as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol.
notes.text: Sheol is the place of the dead.

notes.after: ashes of fire, a very flame of the LORD.
rs. Each was to bring a thousand shekels
notes.text: A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1000 shekels is about 10 kilograms or about 22 pounds.
